title: Policy iteration for Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs equations with control constraints and comparison with Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equations
summary: Convergence of the bilevel policy iteration algorithm for the value function, satisfying the Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs (HJI) equation, is analyzed in the presence of control constraints. Both first and second-order HJI equations corresponding to the deterministic and stochastic systems are considered. For numerical tests, a semi-implicit upwind scheme for backward HJI PDEs is applied and a thorough comparison between the solutions to first and second-order Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equations is presented for both the unconstrained and the constrained control cases.
